items.title: Section: Comprehensive-Gateway Kind Speech — Matched to Four Stages, From First Steps to Resolving Doubt

items.zh: 云何菩薩一切門愛語？當知此語略有四種。一、欲斷諸蓋向善趣者，為說先時所應作法。二、遠離諸蓋心調善者，為說增進四聖諦等相應正法。三、在家出家多放逸者，無倒諫誨，方便令其出離放逸行，住不放逸行。四、於諸法中多疑惑者，為令當來離疑惑故，為說正法論義決擇。
items.en: What is a bodhisattva's comprehensive-gateway kind speech? One should know this speech is, in brief, of four kinds. First, for those wishing to release the five hindrances and move towards a favourable rebirth, teaching the preliminary practices appropriate to that stage. Second, for those already free of the five hindrances, their minds genuinely well settled, teaching the four noble truths and the corresponding true teaching that leads further. Third, for householders and monastics alike who have fallen into carelessness, correctly and without distortion admonishing them, skilfully guiding them out of careless conduct and into genuine diligence. Fourth, for those still caught in genuine doubt about the teaching, resolving that doubt through careful discussion and decisive analysis, so that confusion will not persist into the future.

items.title: Section: Virtuous-Person Kind Speech — the Five Marks of a Genuinely Complete Teaching

items.zh: 云何菩薩善士愛語？當知此語略有五種。謂諸菩薩為所化生，能說如來及諸菩薩有因緣法、有出離法、有所依法、有勇決法、有神變法。若所說法，得處有因，制立學處，是故此法名有因緣。若所說法，於所受學有毀犯者，施設還淨，是故此法名有出離。若所說法，四依所攝，施設無倒法律正行，是故此法名有所依。若所說法，能正顯示出一切苦不退還行，是故此法名有勇決。若所說法，作三神變，一切所說終不唐捐，是故此法名有神變。
items.en: What is a bodhisattva's virtuous-person kind speech? One should know this speech is, in brief, of five kinds. Bodhisattvas, for the sake of beings to be guided, are able to teach the Tathāgata's and bodhisattvas' own teaching that has a genuine reason behind it, teaching that provides a genuine way back to purity, teaching addressing what a practitioner genuinely depends on, teaching bold and decisive enough to carry a practitioner through, and teaching accompanied by miraculous power. Teaching that arose from a genuine, traceable situation, establishing a precept accordingly, is called teaching with a genuine reason. Teaching that, when what was undertaken has been violated, provides a way of restoring purity, is called teaching that provides a genuine way back. Teaching that properly addresses the four basic requisites, establishing correct and undistorted conduct regarding them, is called teaching addressing genuine dependence. Teaching that correctly reveals a path leading entirely out of suffering, never turning back, is called bold and decisive teaching. Teaching accompanied by the three kinds of miraculous manifestation, such that nothing taught is ever wasted, is called teaching with genuine miraculous power.

items.title: Section: Comprehensive-Kind Kind Speech — Discipline's Boundaries, the Four Unimpeded Understandings, and Correcting a Fellow Practitioner Well

items.zh: 云何菩薩一切種愛語？當知此語，六種、七種，總十三種。言六種者，一、於應聽法開聽愛語，二、於應制法遮制愛語，三、開示諸法法門愛語，四、開示無倒法相愛語，五、開示無倒訓釋諸法言詞愛語，六、開示無倒法句品類差別愛語。言七種者，一、慰喻愛語；二、慶悅愛語；三、於他有情一切資具少希欲中，一切所作及以正至少希欲中，廣恣愛語；四、安慰種種驚怖愛語；五、如理宣說所攝愛語；六、為欲令他出不善處安住善處，正見聞疑舉呵愛語；七、請他有力饒益愛語。如是菩薩十三種語，當知名為一切種愛語。
items.en: What is a bodhisattva's comprehensive-kind kind speech? One should know this speech is, in brief, of thirteen kinds altogether — six of one sort and seven of another. The six are: speech opening what should genuinely be permitted; speech restraining what should genuinely be prohibited; speech revealing the various gateways to the teaching; speech revealing its genuine, undistorted characteristics; speech revealing its genuine, undistorted meaning across every language; speech revealing its genuine, undistorted classification into every relevant category. The seven are: comforting speech; celebratory speech; generously accommodating speech, freely explaining, as others wish, how to keep one's wants for every requisite few and what the contentment of those who have rightly reached the noble state is like; speech calming every kind of genuine fear; speech correctly teaching the true doctrine; speech that, in order to guide someone out of an unwholesome state and into a wholesome one, correctly raises a genuinely observed, heard, or suspected fault and offers correction accordingly; and speech requesting a more capable person to offer help one cannot personally provide. These thirteen kinds of speech together should be understood as a bodhisattva's comprehensive-kind kind speech.

items.title: Section: Fulfilling-Requests Kind Speech — Four Pure Foundations, Eight Forms of Simply Honest Testimony

items.zh: 云何菩薩遂求愛語？當知此語略有八種。謂諸菩薩依四淨語，起八聖語，是名菩薩遂求愛語。四淨語者，謂離妄語及以離間、麁惡、綺語。八聖語者，謂見言見，聞言聞，覺言覺，知言知，不見言不見，不聞言不聞，不覺言不覺，不知言不知。
items.en: What is a bodhisattva's fulfilling-requests kind speech? One should know this speech is, in brief, of eight kinds. Bodhisattvas, relying on four pure foundations of speech, give rise to eight forms of noble speech — this is called a bodhisattva's fulfilling-requests kind speech. The four pure foundations are: freedom from falsehood, from divisive speech, from harsh speech, and from idle talk. The eight forms of noble speech are: saying "I saw" of what was genuinely seen, "I heard" of what was genuinely heard, "I sensed" of what was genuinely sensed, and "I know" of what is genuinely known; and saying "I did not see," "I did not hear," "I did not sense," and "I do not know" of what genuinely was not seen, heard, sensed, or known.

items.title: Section: Both-Worlds-Happiness Kind Speech — Relieving Five Classical Griefs, Praising Four Classical Completions

items.zh: 云何菩薩此世他世樂愛語？當知此語略有九種。一、說正法斷親屬難愁憂愛語，二、說正法斷財位難愁憂愛語，三、說正法斷無病難愁憂愛語，四、說正法斷淨戒難眾苦愛語，五、說正法斷正見難眾苦愛語。六、說正法讚美淨戒圓滿愛語，七、說正法讚美正見圓滿愛語，八、說正法讚美軌則圓滿愛語，九、說正法讚美正命圓滿愛語。
items.en: What is a bodhisattva's kind speech of happiness in this world and the next? One should know this speech is, in brief, of nine kinds. First, teaching the true dharma to relieve the grief of losing family. Second, teaching the true dharma to relieve the grief of losing wealth and status. Third, teaching the true dharma to relieve the grief of losing health. Fourth, teaching the true dharma to relieve the suffering of breaking one's precepts. Fifth, teaching the true dharma to relieve the suffering of losing right view. Sixth, teaching the true dharma to praise the genuine fulfilment of pure discipline. Seventh, teaching the true dharma to praise the genuine fulfilment of right view. Eighth, teaching the true dharma to praise the genuine fulfilment of proper conduct. Ninth, teaching the true dharma to praise the genuine fulfilment of an honest livelihood.

items.title: Section: Purity Kind Speech — Twenty Marks of Genuinely Well-Taught Dharma, Closing the Chapter on Kind Speech

items.zh: 云何菩薩清淨愛語？當知此語有二十種。謂二十相宣說正法，應知如前力種性品。
items.en: What is a bodhisattva's purity kind speech? One should know this speech has twenty marks — namely, the twenty marks of genuinely teaching the true dharma, to be understood as described earlier in the chapter on the lineage of the powers.

items.title: Section: Beneficial Conduct Opens — Where Kind Speech Explains, Beneficial Conduct Actually Moves Someone to practise

items.zh: 云何菩薩利行？謂此利行廣如愛語，應知其相。於利行中餘差別義，我今當說。謂諸菩薩，由一切品差別愛語，隨說彼彼趣義利行，饒益有情，故名利行。云何菩薩自性利行？謂諸菩薩由彼愛語，為諸有情示現正理，隨其所應，於諸所學隨義利行，法隨法行。如是行中，安住悲心、無愛染心，勸導、調伏、安處、建立。是名略說利行自性。
items.en: What is a bodhisattva's beneficial conduct? This conduct is, in broad terms, the same as kind speech, and its characteristics should be understood accordingly. There remains, however, a further distinguishing meaning within beneficial conduct, which I will now explain: bodhisattvas, through every distinct form of kind speech already described, correspondingly guide beings towards whatever genuinely benefits them, and it is this active guidance towards genuine benefit that is called beneficial conduct. What is a bodhisattva's beneficial conduct of intrinsic nature? Bodhisattvas, through that same kind speech, reveal correct principles to beings, and, according to what is appropriate, guide them towards genuinely beneficial practice within what they have undertaken to learn, practising in accordance with the teaching itself. In this conduct, bodhisattvas abide in genuine compassion, a mind free of any self-interested attachment, actively encouraging, correcting, settling, and establishing beings in practice. This is, in brief, called the intrinsic nature of beneficial conduct.

blocks.text: The rest of kind speech, then the third means: beneficial conduct.
For those wishing to release the hindrances and reach a good rebirth, teaching the preliminaries; and so on to those doubting dependent origination ("does good really bring good results?").
Teaching "that has a reason behind it, a way back to purity, a basis, resolute effort, and wonders". Master Cháng Bǎi: a reason concerns the precepts; a way back, confession.

Including "speech opening what should be permitted; speech restraining what should be prohibited". Venerable Miào Jìng: raising a problem that was seen, heard, or suspected, and rebuking you for it, is also kind speech.
"Saying 'seen' for what was seen, 'heard' for what was heard, … 'not known' for what was not known." Master Cháng Bǎi: noble speech has truthfulness as its nature.
Teaching the Dharma to relieve the grief of losing family, wealth, position, health.
Pure kind speech has the twenty marks of good teaching (Day 341).

Like kind speech, but it goes further: "through every form of kind speech, bodhisattvas correspondingly lead beings towards conduct that benefits them". Venerable Miào Jìng: hearing, reflecting, and practising in accord with the Dharma.

quiz.q: The first comprehensive-gateway kind speech is addressed to whom, and what is said?
options: to those wishing to cut the hindrances and move towards good rebirth, the preliminary practices
quiz.why: "For those wishing to release the hindrances and move towards a favourable rebirth, teaching the preliminary practices." Master Cháng Bǎi: teach talks on giving and the like. Venerable Miào Jìng: first worldly good as foundation, then the world-transcending path — that is the order of teaching.

quiz.q: What five kinds of teaching does the good person's kind speech convey?
options: teaching with a reason, with a way out, with a basis, with resolute effort, with wonders
quiz.why: Teaching "that has a genuine reason behind it, a way back to purity, a basis, resolute effort, and wonders." Venerable Miào Jìng: every precept arose from a particular occasion — hence "the occasion has a cause."

quiz.q: Among the six comprehensive-kind kind speeches, what are the first two?
options: speech permitting what should be permitted, speech prohibiting what should be prohibited
quiz.why: "Speech opening what should genuinely be permitted; speech restraining what should genuinely be prohibited." Venerable Miào Jìng: these first two pertain to the precepts.

quiz.q: "Kind speech raising and rebuking what is seen, heard, or suspected" — what does Venerable Miào Jìng say, and what does Master Cháng Bǎi stress?
options: raising and rebuking what is seen, heard, or suspected is kind speech too; Cháng Bǎi: best done privately, not in front of many — that is timeliness
quiz.why: Venerable Miào Jìng: when there's a problem seen, heard, or suspected, raising it and rebuking you — that is kind speech, you should know. Master Cháng Bǎi: preferably admonish in private, not when many are present — that is timeliness.

quiz.q: Fulfilling-requests kind speech: "relying on four pure foundations, giving rise to eight noble words." What are the eight?
options: saying "seen" when seen … and "not known" when not known
quiz.why: "Saying 'seen' for what was seen, 'heard' for what was heard … 'not known' for what was not known." Master Cháng Bǎi: the eight noble words are true speech arising from seeing, hearing, sensing, and knowing.

quiz.q: Among the nine kinds of two-world kind speech, which griefs do the first three relieve?
options: grief over loss of family, wealth and status, and health
quiz.why: "Teaching the true dharma to relieve the grief of losing family; … of losing wealth and status; … of losing health." Master Cháng Bǎi: wealth is shared by five — flood, fire, bandits, bad rulers, and wastrel heirs.

quiz.q: Why is beneficial conduct so called?
options: through every kind of kind speech, correspondingly leading beings to act towards benefit
quiz.why: "Bodhisattvas, through every distinct form of kind speech, correspondingly lead beings towards conduct that benefits them — hence 'beneficial conduct.'" Master Cháng Bǎi: kind speech is understanding, beneficial conduct is practice; the two must advance together.
